ignitions.name: Origin
ignitions.provenance: Time from NIST TN 2252 Sec. 1.2 ('at approximately 06:20 on November 8, 2018'); place from NIST fire observation 0001 (origin, first 911 report).

perimeters.method: FEDS satellite-derived (VIIRS active fire) cumulative perimeter
perimeters.time_note: FEDS snaps each perimeter to local noon or midnight; times are UTC derived with America/Los_Angeles. Between snapshots the front is interpolated, not observed.

sources.provider: NASA VEDA Fire Event Data Suite (FEDS) large-fire perimeter archive
sources.license: not stated on the VEDA collection endpoint
